name: The Bath
summary: A painted clay tub on its plinth, a stone basin, painted lilies and a great deal of scented oil, all of it for one person.
description: Kings bathe, and this king bathes in a painted clay tub on a gypsum plinth, with water jars stood ready at either end and a channel cut in the floor to carry the water away out of the south door. A stone basin on its pedestal waits in the other corner for the washing of hands before an offering, and the walls are painted with lilies at a sitting height, since nobody stands up in a bath. The shelf of scented oil is worth more than it looks, and every flask on it will break if dropped.
source: the bathroom at Pylos (plan); art bible palette (docs/art/bronze.md)
build: Shell: the kit's Keep shell, 12.0 × 12.0 × 0.30 m slab, 0.50 m painted plaster walls 4.60 m clear, 0.45 m haematite capstone band, an archway 2.60 × 3.31 m centred on every wall.
Lily fresco: a panel 4.10 m wide × 1.20 m tall, 1.20–2.40 m above the floor, on each section of the north, east and west walls, with a 0.16 m haematite spiral border on top.
Lustral basin (NW): a gypsum foot r 0.25 × 0.10 m, a tapered pedestal 0.72 m, and a bowl r 0.45 → 0.55 × 0.20 m on top (rim at 1.30 m above ground), water in it, at (−4.20, 4.20).
Tub: painted clay 1.60 × 0.70 × 0.60 m on the plinth, a 0.14 m haematite spiral band round it, water 0.03 m below the rim (at 1.05 m above ground).
Hydriae: two water jars 0.62 m tall, belly 0.40 m, at (2.45, 5.00) and (5.10, 3.60).
Water channel: a flat 0.10 m strip in the floor, south from the tub's plinth at x 3.05 to the crossing, west along y 0 to the centre, then south to the south archway.
Bench (SE): a plastered clay bench 3.20 × 0.50 × 0.40 m against the south wall at x 3.60; two folded towels 0.45 × 0.35 × 0.10 m on it.
Oil shelf (SW): a timber shelf unit 2.60 m wide against the south wall at x −3.70, three boards (0.35, 0.90, 1.45 m); four oil flasks 0.22 m tall on each board.
Oil stand: a painted offering table 0.60 × 0.60 m, 0.70 m high, at (−4.80, −2.60).
sockets: Archway ×4, centred on each wall: 2.60 × 3.31 m (Keep), all open
Water channel: exits through the south archway at floor level

materials.name: Haematite red
materials.notes: Spiral borders, the tub's band, capstone.

materials.name: Water
materials.notes: In the tub, the basin and the floor channel.

gameplay: The oil flasks are fragile, flammable loot: dropped they break, and spilled oil takes IGNIS.
The tub is waist-high cover in the NE; the rest of the room is open.
The floor channel leads to the south archway, so this room usually sits beside a service room.
